## Kimi K3 E2EE API

Kimi K3 E2EE is a large language model by Moonshot AI, available on the Venice API as `e2ee-kimi-k3-p`. It is end-to-end encrypted. It is also available without end-to-end encryption, as [Kimi K3](/models/kimi-k3).

Kimi K3 is a 2.8T parameter open-weight multimodal reasoning model from Moonshot AI. It is suited for complex coding, knowledge work, and long-horizon agentic workflows.

### Kimi K3 E2EE API pricing

| Model ID | Variant | Privacy | Price |
|---|---|---|---|
| `e2ee-kimi-k3-p` | E2EE | E2EE | $3.75 / $18.75 per 1M |

### Kimi K3 E2EE specifications

| Spec | Value |
|---|---|
| Provider | Moonshot AI |
| Released | Sep 8, 2026 |
| Privacy | E2EE |
| Status | Stable |
| Open weights | Yes |
| Context window | 1M tokens |
| Max output | 128K tokens |
| Reasoning effort | none, max |

### How to use the Kimi K3 E2EE API

Send requests to `POST https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/chat/completions` with `"model": "e2ee-kimi-k3-p"` and your API key.

```bash
curl https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VENICE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "e2ee-kimi-k3-p",
    "messages": [{ "role": "user", "content": "Explain TEE attestation in two sentences." }],
    "reasoning_effort": "max"
  }'
```
